items.text: Merrill announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services combining automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed investment strategies.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed investment strategies in the Merrill Lynch Investment Advisory Program (IAP).

items.text: Merrill's Head of Fiduciary Programs and Platforms, Jay Link, stated that the new TET and DCA services help clients address the challenge of transitioning appreciated assets without realizing all of the tax impact at once and investing cash without feeling pressured to time the market.
items.quote: Investors often face two common challenges: how to transition appreciated assets without realizing all of the tax impact at once, and how to invest cash without feeling pressured to time the market," said Jay Link, Head of Fiduciary Programs and Platforms at Merrill. "These services help clients to stay focused on their long-term financial goals."

items.text: Merrill's Head of Managed Account Advisors, John Capelli, stated that the new TET and DCA capabilities reflect a continued focus on making it easier for advisors to implement personalized investment strategies at scale.
items.quote: These new capabilities reflect our continued focus on making it easier for advisors to implement personalized investment strategies at scale," said John Capelli, Head of Managed Account Advisors at Merrill.

items.text: Merrill was recognized more than any other firm, with 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list, indicating a strong bench of next-generation advisors.
items.quote: Recognized more than any other firm, Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list
items.unit: advisors named to Forbes Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors list

items.text: CFO Alastair Borthwick stated Merrill is picking up recruiting of experienced advisors and running a training program in wealth management to drive net new flows.
items.quote: I think the Merrill FA see the value of our franchise and how they can help their own clients over a long period of time, and we're picking up the recruiting of experienced advisors. That isn't an enormous part of our strategy, but it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: Merrill executives touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm returned to veteran broker recruiting under Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. The firm largely pulled back from veteran broker recruiting at the end of 2017 but returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.

items.text: Merrill operates an Advisor Development Program designed to help candidates build their book of high-net-worth clients and progress through roles to become a Merrill Core Advisor.
items.quote: If you're interested in a career in wealth management and possess the entrepreneurial spirit - the Advisor Development Program is for you. Roles are designed to enhance your ability to meet and help clients identify financial goals, align banking and investing solutions and build your book of high-net worth clients.
